en.headline: Hong Kong Disneyland starts A Disney Christmas season today
en.dek: The resort begins its festive programme from 17 November to 3 January, with a new Winter Market in World of Frozen and a daytime castle show from Wednesday.
body: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort said its annual A Disney Christmas celebration begins today, 17 November, and continues until 3 January 2027.
The programme includes the return of the Holiday Wish-Come-True tree lighting ceremony on Main Street, U.S.A., featuring Santa Goofy, music, lights, drones and snowfall effects.

In World of Frozen, guests can visit an all-new festive Winter Market. A new daytime Christmas party show with Mickey, Minnie and Stitch starts on 19 November in front of the Castle of Magical Dreams.
Disney Christmas Live in Concert returns for two weekends on 21-22 November and 5-6 December. Park admission is required, with some experiences needing separate tickets or reservations.

zh.headline: 香港迪士尼今日啟動奇妙聖誕季節
zh.dek: 度假區由11月17日至明年1月3日舉辦節日活動，魔雪奇緣世界新增冬日市集，周三起有日間城堡演出。
body: 香港迪士尼樂園度假區表示，一年一度的「A Disney Christmas」奇妙聖誕由今日11月17日起至2027年1月3日舉行。
節目包括美國小鎮大街的「聖誕願望成真」亮燈儀式，由聖誕高飛帶領，配合音樂、燈光、無人機及飄雪效果。
魔雪奇緣世界設有全新冬日市集。11月19日起，奇妙夢想城堡前將有米奇、米妮與史迪仔的日間聖誕派對演出。
「迪士尼聖誕音樂Live！」將於11月21至22日及12月5至6日兩個週末再度上演。入場須持有效門票，部分體驗需另購門票或預約。
